name: Saw Comb
author: Emilie Gillet
description: A band-limited exciter through a comb whose pitch is decoupled from the played note, with genuinely bipolar feedback.

controls.label: Resonance
controls.description: Sweeps comb feedback from inverted through a single echo to ringing resonance.

controls.label: Comb pitch
controls.description: Detunes the comb up to five octaves either side of the played note.

controls.label: Exciter
controls.description: Morphs the exciter from a bright saw to a narrow pulse.

controls.label: Loop tilt
controls.description: Damps the feedback loop below noon and brightens it above.
